name: Yard fence bonding interface
aliases: switchyards Switchyard earthing and lightning interfaces
summary: Identifies the assigned connection or isolation treatment of the yard fence in the earthing design.
description: Identifies the assigned connection or isolation treatment of the yard fence in the earthing design. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Fence earthing interface” at the input and “Documented fence treatment” at the output. Fence treatment is site-specific.
